title: A little sturdier than off brand pans
text: A little sturdier than off brand pans. Reynolds disposable pans are a little thicker than some other brands, making it easier and safer to carry your cake.  I would still be sure it has some support as it is not like a normal baking pan.  For disposable, it's pretty strong.  It's also great for casseroles and other baking goods.  The non-stick works out pretty well, too.  Love the domed lid, not smeared frosting!
